name: Makita DUC303 / DUC353 / DUC400
blurb: 36 V saws. Standard bars 12″ / 14″ / 16″. Manual: 90PX (.043″) or 91PX (.050″), 46, 52 and 56 drive links.
intro: Makita's DUC303, DUC353 and DUC400 share one chain table. Standard bars are 300 mm (12″) on the DUC303, 350 mm (14″) on the DUC353 and 400 mm (16″) on the DUC400, and the manual recommends 300–400 mm for all three. Two chain types are listed at each length: 90PX at 1.1 mm and 91PX at 1.3 mm, 46, 52 and 56 drive links. Makita prints the pitch as 3/8″. Echo's chart classes 90PX and 91PX as 3/8″ low profile, which is the pitch used here. The manual does not print separate bar part numbers in this table.

bars.label: 12″ / 300 mm (90PX)
bars.note: Makita's DUC303/DUC353/DUC400 manual: chain type 90PX, 46 drive links, guide bar 300 mm (12″), pitch 3/8″, gauge 1.1 mm, sprocket-nose bar. 1.1 mm is .043″ and 1.3 mm is .050″. Echo's chart classes 90PX as 3/8″ low profile. Makita prints the 90PX round file as 4.5 mm (3/16″). 4.5 mm is 11/64″. Standard bar: DUC303 300 mm, DUC353 350 mm, DUC400 400 mm. The manual lists 300–400 mm as the recommended range for all three.
